context_requirements: Active Notch signaling (expression of Notch receptors and ligands such as JAG1/DLL1)
Presence of gamma-secretase complex components (PSEN1/PSEN2, NCSTN, APH1, PEN2)
Notch-dependent transcriptional program (HES/HEY target genes) driving proliferation or survival
For strong response, lineage with high Notch pathway activity (e.g., lung, colon, breast, T-ALL)
falsifiers: No decrease in HES1, HEY1, HES5, or DTX1 mRNA at 6 h or 24 h in any cell line
No change in Notch target gene expression despite confirmed gamma-secretase inhibition
Increase in Notch target genes (HES1, HEY1) after treatment
No antiproliferative or apoptotic signature at 24 h in Notch-dependent lines
Similar transcriptional response in Notch-inactive lines as in Notch-active lines

evidence.supports: Gamma-secretase inhibitor alters Notch-dependent gene expression including adipsin in gastrointestinal tissue
Gamma-secretase inhibitor MRK-003 inhibits Notch3 signaling, reduces proliferation, and induces apoptosis in lung cancer lines
Gamma-secretase inhibitors block Notch activation and induce apoptosis in Kaposi's sarcoma tumor cells
Gamma-secretase inhibitor blocks Notch-1 activation and affects Notch target genes Hey1, Hes1, Hes5 in breast cancer cells
Gamma-secretase inhibitor PF-03084014 reduces NICD and downregulates Notch target genes Hes-1 and cMyc, causing cell cycle arrest and apoptosis
